items.snippet: 일본에 유학을 간 지 이틀 만에 아르바이트 자리를 구했다. 오사카 도톤보리(大阪道頓堀)에 있는 야키니쿠(燒肉) 식당이었다. 낮에는 학교에 다니고 오후부터 밤늦게까지 식당에서 일하는 조건이었다. 숙식을 제공하는 스미코미(住み込み·입주 근무) 형태여서 식당에서 걸어서 10분 거리에 있는 기숙사에서 생활했다. 기숙사에는 이미 조리사 두 명이 살고 있었다. 두 사람은 방을 하나씩 차지했고, 나는 거실에서 잠을 잤다. 이상한 것은 두 조리사가 도무지 말을 하지 않는다는 점이었다. 출근할 때 인사를 해도 대답이 없었다. 기숙사에서도 마찬가지였다. 처음에는 두 사람이 말을 못 하는 줄 알았다.

items.title: 김민석 “조희대 탄핵 모든 방법 논의” 당 차원 추진 공식화
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 김민석 대표가 “탄핵에 대해서는 광범위한 요구가 이미 나오고 있기 때문에 모든 방법과 어떤 경로를 올려놓고 논의하기 시작했다”며 조희대 대법원장에 대한 탄핵 추진을 공식화했다. 당내 강경파 및 친청(친정청래)계와의 갈등 국면에서 여권이 ‘원 보이스’로 뭉칠 수 있는 카드를 꺼내 든 것. 김 대표는 16일 ‘민주당TV’에서 “어느 시점까지는 탄핵의 ‘ㅌ(티읕)’ 자도 내지 않고 진행을 해 왔는데 이제는 사퇴하지 않으면 안 되는 이유를 종합적으로 정리를 해 가고 있다”며 이같이 말했다. 신현영 대변인은 이날 부산 최고위원회의를 마친 후 기자들과 만나 “여러 위법한 부분들에 대해 정리하면서 어떻게 대응할지 시간을 갖고 논의할 예정”이라고 설명했다. 김 대표의 이 같은 강수를 두고선 당내 갈등을 고려해 여론 전환을 시도한 것 아니냐는 해...

items.title: ‘닥공’ 한다더니 올 수도권 착공 37% 그쳐… “최대 5만채 미달 전망”
items.snippet: 정부가 예고했던 올해 수도권 착공 물량이 당초 발표보다 최소 3만 채 이상 미달할 것으로 전망된다. 정부는 지난 1년여간 3차례의 주택 공급 계획 발표를 통해 올 한 해 26만8000채를 착공하겠다고 밝힌 바 있다. 그러나 10월 둘째 주 기준 착공 물량은 9만9000채로 목표치의 37%에 그치는 것으로 나타났다. 4분기(10∼12월) 착공 물량을 극대화한다고 해도 당초 발표의 80%대에 머무를 것이란 분석이 나온다.● 4분기 ‘올인’해도 목표치 미달국토교통부와 국무조정실 등은 16일 정부서울청사에서 진행한 첫 주택공급 정례 브리핑에서 이 같은 내용의 착공 현황을 발표했다. 착공 물량을 부문별로 보면 공공주택은 목표치인 6만2000채 가운데 1만6200채(26.1%)를 착공했다. 3기 신도시 7300채와 서울 내 노후청사 복합개발 417채 등...

items.title: 김민석 ‘曺 탄핵’ 카드로 강성층 결집 노려… 실제 발의는 미지수
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 김민석 대표가 조희대 대법원장 탄핵 추진을 공식화한 것은 당청 모두 지지율 침체를 벗어나지 못하는 상황에서 강성 지지층 결집을 위한 것으로 풀이된다. 최근 김지용 초대 중대범죄수사청장 인선을 두고 강경파가 이재명 대통령과 공개 대립각을 세우는 등 내홍이 고스란히 표출된 만큼 지지층 달래기에 나섰다는 취지다. 그러나 비판 여론과 당내 우려가 이어지는 만큼 실제 탄핵소추안 발의까지 이어질지는 미지수다.● 중수청장-신천지 논란 돌파구 마련 민주당이 조 대법원장에 대한 탄핵을 거론한 것은 이번이 처음이 아니다. 민주당은 지난해엔 대법원의 이 대통령 공직선거법 위반 사건 파기환송을 대선 개입으로 규정하고 조 대법원장을 압박했다. 올 3월에는 조 대법원장이 민주당이 강행한 ‘사법개혁 3법’에 대한 공개 우려를 표하자 범여권 강경파 의원들은...

items.title: ‘국무회의 생중계’ 논란에, 李 “비공개 주장 동의 못해” 일축
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 16일 국무회의 생중계 논란과 관련해 “국무회의를 전부 비공개하자는 일각의 주장에 대해 저는 동의할 수 없다”고 밝혔다. 앞서 소셜네트워크서비스(SNS) 활동을 자제할 의사가 없다는 뜻을 밝힌 데 이어 국무회의 생중계를 축소할 뜻이 없음을 분명히 한 것. 여권 일각에서도 “대통령이 공개 발언을 줄여야 한다”는 요구가 나오지만 ‘집권 2기’에도 기존 국정 운영 방식을 바꿀 뜻이 없음을 강조한 것이다. 이 대통령은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에 ‘국무총리 만찬에서 생중계 국무회의에 대한 국무위원들의 우려가 있었다’는 취지의 보도를 거론하며 “국무회의 공개를 통해 국무위원의 말을 막고 있다는 허위 주장에 대해 깊은 유감을 표한다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 국무회의를 비공개해야 한다는 주장에 대해서는 “중간 유통업자들이 생산자-소비자...

items.title: 서울고법원장 “제청권-임명권 간 우열 없어”
items.snippet: 김대웅 서울고등법원장이 16일 청와대와 대법원이 충돌하고 있는 대법원장의 대법관 후보 제청권과 대통령의 임명권에 대해 “우열이 있다고 생각하지 않는다”고 했다. 또 이재명 대통령 관련 형사재판 중단에 대해서는 헌법에 근거한 조치라며 위법하지 않다는 입장을 밝혔다. 이날 국회 법제사법위원회의 서울고법과 서울중앙지법 등 17개 법원에 대한 국정감사에서 김 원장은 “제청권과 동의권, 임명권 사이에 우열이 있다고 생각하지는 않는다”고 했다. 그러면서도 대법관 공백 장기화에 대해선 “바람직하지 않다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령의 공직선거법 재판과 대장동 사건 재판 등이 중단된 것을 두고도 여야의 공방이 이어졌다. 국민의힘 김태규 의원은 “(이 대통령 재판 중단은) 직무유기 혹은 소송지휘권을 남용하고 있다고 볼 수 있지 않겠느냐”고 지적했다. 반면 더불어민주...

items.title: [단독]올해도 ‘도돌이표 국감’… 고령자 운전면허 반납 6년째 지적
items.snippet: 국민의힘 권영진 의원은 12일 국회 행정안전위원회의 경찰청 국정감사에서 “어르신들에게 10만 원짜리 교통카드를 하나 던져주는 일률적 정책으로는 고령 운전자 사고를 막을 수 없다”고 지적했다. 2021년 국감 이후 더불어민주당 박찬대·이형석 의원, 국민의힘 고동진·배준영 의원 등 여야를 가리지 않고 “고령자의 운전면허 반납을 유도하기 위해 고령자 대체교통 수단 확보 등 근본 대책이 필요하다”는 취지의 지적이 반복되고 있지만 6년째 문제 해결은 되지 않고 올해 국감장에서도 도돌이표처럼 등장한 것. 실제 고령 운전자 면허 반납률은 최근 5년간 2.1∼2.5%에 머물고 있다. 그 사이 2024년 7월 서울시청역 역주행 사고, 지난달 경기 안성 나눔장터 돌진 사고 등 고령 운전자에 의한 사망 사고는 잇따랐다. 국회예산정책처는 지난해 ‘국회 시정요구 사...

items.title: 李 “부마항쟁-5·18, 헌법 전문에 담는 개헌 필요”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 16일 모교인 중앙대 개교 110주년을 맞아 캠퍼스를 방문해 ‘과잠’(대학교 학과 잠바)을 입고 학생들과 소통했다. 현직 대통령이 재임 중 출신 대학을 찾은 것은 처음이다. 이 대통령은 이날 오전 서울 동작구 중앙대에서 열린 기념식 축사를 통해 “대학 시절 알게 된 5·18민주화운동의 진실과 캠퍼스에서 경험한 배움과 연대의 가치가 삶을 바꾼 소중한 밑거름이 됐다”고 했다. 또 “대학 시절을 돌아보니 참으로 귀하고 소중한 시절이었다”며 “시간이 곧 삶이자 생명인 만큼 가지고 있는 시간을 귀히 여겨야 한다”고 당부했다. 이 대통령은 중앙대 교훈인 ‘의에 죽고 참에 산다’를 언급하면서 “의혈 중앙 여러분을 응원하고 사랑합니다”라고 했다. 청와대 강유정 수석대변인은 서면 브리핑을 통해 “중앙대는 개교 이래 첫 특별공로상 수상자로 이...

items.title: 정당 지지율, 민주 36% vs 국힘 27%
items.snippet: 더불어민주당과 국민의힘의 정당 지지도가 2주 연속으로 한 자릿수 격차를 유지했다는 여론조사 결과가 16일 나왔다. 6·3 지방선거 이전 2배 이상으로 벌어지기도 했던 양당 지지율 격차가 좁혀지는 추세인 것. 내후년 총선에 대한 견해를 묻는 항목에선 “야당이 승리해야 한다”는 답변이 “여당 승리”를 기대하는 답변보다 우세한 것으로 나타났다. 한국갤럽이 13∼15일 전국 유권자 1003명을 대상으로 조사해 16일 발표한 여론조사(전화면접 방식, 95% 신뢰수준에 표본오차 ±3.1%포인트, 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조)에 따르면 민주당과 국민의힘 지지율은 36%, 27%를 기록했다. 직전 주 조사에서 각각 35%, 26%였던 만큼 2주 연속으로 9%포인트 격차가 유지됐다. 6·3 지방선거 전이었던 4월 첫 주 조사에서 30...

items.title: 산업부 차관 박동일, 금융위 부위원장에 신진창
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 16일 산업통상부 차관에 박동일 산업부 산업정책실장(56)을, 금융위원회 부위원장에 신진창 금융위 사무처장(56)을 각각 임명하는 등 2명의 차관급 인선을 단행했다. 산업부, 금융위 모두 내부 승진 인사로 정책·업무 연속성과 실무형 발탁에 중점을 둔 것으로 보인다. 청와대 강유정 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑을 통해 이같이 밝혔다. 전북 전주 출신인 박 신임 차관은 산업부 소재부품장비협력관, 원전산업정책국장, 제조산업정책관 등을 지냈다. 강 수석대변인은 “산업정책 전반의 기획·조정과 주력 제조업 육성 현장 등을 폭넓게 경험한 산업정책 전문가”라며 “최근 충청권의 대규모 투자계획 이행을 위한 민관합동 태스크포스(TF)를 원활하게 이끌어가는 등 산업 현장에 대한 높은 이해와 민관 협력 조정 역량을 꾸준히 입증해 왔다”고 말했다....

items.title: ‘딸 교수 임용 특혜 의혹’ 유승민 등 4명 송치

items.title: “땅값 반토막났는데 농지조사까지… 거래도 대출도 막혀”
items.snippet: 박영규(72)씨는 경기 여주시에서 태어나 평생 농사만 지었다. 부모에게 물려받은 땅에 농사를 지으며 조금씩 사들인 땅까지, 그가 가진 농지는 총 1만3000평이다. 박씨에게는 노후 생활비로 쓰려고 평생 모은 ‘퇴직금’이 이 땅이다. 농사를 그만두려고 마음먹은 지 한참이 됐지만, 몇 년째 땅을 못 팔고 있다. 박씨는 “평당 20만원 하던 땅인데 지금은 10만원에 내놔도 쳐다보는 사람도 없다”며 “땅값이 떨어지니까 농지를 담보로 돈을 빌리기도 어려워졌다”고 했다.

items.title: “이대론 재판 못해” “공소사실에 흠결” 재판부 질책 받은 2차 특검
items.snippet: “이 상태로는 재판을 진행할 수 없습니다.” 지난 15일 서울중앙지법 508호. ‘순직 해병’ 사건 수사를 방해한 혐의로 기소된 이시원 전 대통령실 공직기강비서관 등의 직권남용 등 사건 재판에서 형사32부 류경진 재판장이 2차 종합특검을 질책했다. 특검팀이 제출한 증거목록에 어떤 공소사실을 입증하기 위한 증거들인지 구분돼 있지 않았기 때문이다. 3대 특검(내란·김건희·해병)이 다 못한 수사를 이어받아 수사하면서, 무리한 수사, 무더기 기소 등 논란이 끊이지 않았던 2차 특검이 법정에서도 물의를 일으키고 있다. 공소장을 잘못 쓰거나, 수사기록을 피고인 측에 제때 제공하지 않아 재판 진행에 차질을 빚고 있는 것이다. 법조계에선 “수사도 무리하게 하더니 기소도 졸속으로 했다는 게 재판에서 다 드러나고 있다”는 말이 나왔다.

items.title: 北인공기 그려진 미사일 모형 설치… 노원구 미술축제 논란
items.snippet: 서울 노원구가 16일 개막한 공공 미술 축제에 북한 인공기가 그려진 미사일 조형물이 설치됐다. 시민들 사이에선 “시민이 오가는 공공 장소에 북한 인공기가 그려진 작품을 설치하는 게 말이 되느냐”는 비판이 나왔다. 이에 대해 노원구는 “해당 작품이 당초 계획안과 다르게 설치됐다”고 해명했다.

items.title: ‘딸 임용 특혜 의혹’ 경찰, 유승민 송치
items.snippet: 인천경찰청은 유담(32) 인천대 교수의 ‘임용 특혜’ 의혹과 관련해 아버지 유승민 전 국회의원과 이인재 인천대 총장 등 4명을 업무방해 혐의로 공소청에 송치했다고 16일 밝혔다. 이 총장과 교수 A씨에게는 청탁금지법 위반 혐의도 적용했다.

items.title: 반도체 배우러, 폴리텍대 다시 가는 직장인들
items.snippet: 4년제 대학에서 영상애니메이션디자인을 전공한 김희건(27)씨는 졸업 후 게임 업계 취업을 준비하다 올해 한국폴리텍대 대구캠퍼스 그린반도체시스템과에 다시 입학했다. 최근 생성형 인공지능(AI)이 급속도로 발전하면서 디자인 분야 채용이 줄어드는 것을 보고 진로를 바꾼 것이다. AI 산업이 커질수록 반도체도 유망할 것이라는 생각이 들었다고 한다. 김씨는 “SK하이닉스에서 ‘억 소리’ 나는 성과급이 나온다는 이야기도 진로 선택에 영향을 미쳤다”고 했다.

items.title: 옹기종기 모여 ‘보랏빛 향기’
items.snippet: 16일 오전 대전 유성구 유림공원을 찾은 어린이들이 보랏빛 국화꽃 향기를 맡으며 즐거운 시간을 보내고 있다. 이곳에선 17일부터 다음 달 1일까지 대전시 대표 가을 행사인 ‘유성국화축제’가 펼쳐지며, 개막 당일에는 축하 음악회와 드론 쇼 등이 열린다.

items.title: 미인가 국제학교들 “대안교육기관 받아달라”
items.snippet: 교육 당국의 고발 조치와 폐쇄 명령으로 문 닫을 위기에 처한 미인가 국제학교들이 법 개정을 통해 ‘대안교육기관’으로 등록하게 해달라고 국회에 요구하고 나섰다. 16일 본지 취재에 따르면, 미인가 국제학교 100여 곳은 최근 여러 국회의원실을 찾아 대안교육기관법 개정을 요청했으며, 조만간 관련 법안이 발의될 것으로 알려졌다. 교육 당국은 이들 미인가 국제학교에 불법 운영 사실을 2차례 고지했고, 시정하지 않으면 경찰에 고발·수사의뢰할 수 있다며 최후통첩한 상황이다.

items.title: 홍경수 한국언론학회장
items.snippet: 홍경수 아주대 문화콘텐츠학과 교수가 17일 제53대 한국언론학회 회장에 취임한다. 고려대 신문방송학과를 나온 홍 회장은 1995년 KBS PD로 입사해 ‘낭독의 발견’ ‘단박인터뷰’ 등을 기획했다. 한국언론학회 부회장, 방송과 뉴미디어 연구회 회장을 역임했다. 임기는 1년.

items.title: [플라자] 미국 스탠퍼드대학, ‘나이트-헤네시 장학생(KHS)’ 설명회
items.snippet: ▲미국 스탠퍼드대학이 석박사 과정 대학원생에게 3년까지 등록금과 생활비를 지급하는 ‘나이트-헤네시 장학생(KHS)’ 설명회를 19~21일 한국에서 개최한다. 19일은 연세대, 20일은 고려대, 21일은 KAIST에서 열린다. 설명회는 스탠퍼드대 한국총동문회(회장 김재열)의 후원 협찬으로 마련됐다.

items.title: “녹음합니다, 저를 지킬 최후의 보루니까요”
items.snippet: 정구승 법무법인 일로 대표 변호사는 최근 사건 의뢰를 받으면 가장 먼저 던지는 질문이 있다. 바로 사건의 ‘녹음 증거’를 가지고 있느냐는 것. 정 변호사는 “가정폭력이나 사기, 성범죄처럼 외부에 잘 드러나지 않는 범행에 휘말린 경우에는 자신에게 유리한 녹취록을 수사기관에 제출하는 게 필수”라며 “안 그래도 사건이 몰려 처리가 느린 경찰이 보완수사까지 떠맡게 되면서 피의자와 피해자 모두 공정하고 빠른 종결을 위해 사건 실체를 담은 녹음 증거 수집이 더 중요해졌다”고 말했다.

items.title: 화산이 만든 천상의 습지… 100㎏ 짐 메고 목도를 걷는 ‘짐꾼 수행자’를 만나다
items.snippet: 2016년 여름 늦은 밤, 귀가를 신고하듯 습관처럼 TV를 켰다. 광활한 초록 속 끝없는 목도, 자기 키만 한 짐을 진 짐꾼이 그 길을 걷고 있었다. 구도자처럼 보였다. 박혁지 감독의 다큐멘터리 ‘길 위의 인생-인생을 짊어지고, 일본 봇카(歩荷)’였다. ‘오제(尾瀬)’는 ‘천상의 화원’이라 불린다는데, 예쁜 발음이라 마음에 쏙 새겨졌다.

items.title: “당신은 우리 편인가, 남의 편인가”… 연예인 정치색 따지는 사회
items.snippet: #1. “혹시 박진영 위원장은 저쪽에 섰나.” 7일 국회 문화체육관광위원회 국정감사에서 조은희 국민의힘 의원이 박진영 대중문화교류위원회 공동위원장에게 이렇게 말하자, 박 위원장은 두 손으로 얼굴을 감싸며 실소를 보였다. 조 의원은 박 위원장이 이재명 대통령과 함께 찍은 사진을 언급하며 “(박 위원장의) 명성이 이 정권의 흥망과 같이 가는 것 아닌가, 걱정을 하게 됐다”고 말했다. 이에 박 위원장은 “이 정권이나 민주당을 위해 일한다는 생각은 1초도 해본 적이 없다”고 해명했다.

items.title: 위스키, 위기일까 기회일까
items.snippet: 스카치위스키가 위기라고 한다. 스코틀랜드 창고에서 숙성 중인 오크통은 약 2200만 통, 50억L가 넘는다. 영국 파이낸셜타임스(FT)는 이 가운데 팔릴 양보다 더 만들어 쌓아 둔 잉여 원액만 14억L에 달한다고 보도했다. 10년 전 4억L에도 못 미치던 양이 3.5배 이상으로 불어난 것이다. 2008년 리먼 브러더스 사태 이후 저금리로 갈 곳 잃은 돈이 위스키 같은 실물자산으로 몰렸다. 결정적 계기는 코로나19였다. ‘홈술’ 열풍 속에 오래 두고 마실 수 있는 위스키가 주목받았다. 업계가 더 많이 만들어 쌓아 둔 건 당연한 선택이었다.

items.title: 짧고 굵게, 아파트 명칭도 재건축 바람
items.snippet: 이름에는 당대의 미감이 담긴다. 이를테면 1970년대 지어진 서울 서초 신동아1·2차아파트는 반세기 전 작명 규칙에 충실한 이름이었다. 지난해 재건축 공사에 돌입해 곧 고급 주거 단지로 천지개벽할 이 아파트, 새 이름이 관건이었다. 2017년 건설사가 제시한 건 ‘아크로 클라우드 파크’였다. 구름 위 천상 공원. 건설사 브랜드 뒤에 거창한 펫네임(petname·별칭)을 붙이는, 10년 전 유행에 부합하는 이름. 그랬던 이름은 2022년 ‘아크로 드 서초’로 확 줄었고, 지난 4월 한 글자가 더 줄어 ‘아크로 서초’로 최종 확정됐다.

items.title: 상대 아픈 곳 찌르고 조롱하는 말
items.snippet: 가려운 데가 있으면 손톱으로 시원하게 긁어야 하고, 기분 좋은 일이 있으면 화끈하게 카드를 긁어야 한다. 사전에 올라 있는 ‘긁다’의 첫 번째 뜻과 마지막 뜻은 이러하다. 갈퀴로 나뭇잎을 긁고 주걱으로 누룽지를 긁는 것은 순한 뜻이다. 그러나 남을 헐뜯거나 재산을 빼앗는 것, 남의 기분을 상하게 하거나 공연히 일을 키우는 것, 기관총을 마구 쏘아대는 것은 그리 좋은 뜻은 아니다. 그런데 요즘의 쓰임을 보면 ‘긁?’도 사전에 올려야 하는 것은 아닌가 하는 의문이 든다.

items.title: 미야자키 하야오도 반한 이끼의 섬
items.snippet: 오제를 걷다 보면 때때로 깊은 산을 통과해야 할 때가 있다. 길은 가파른데 유혹하는 것들이 많다. 삼나무와 이끼다. 그러나 오제의 이끼를 ‘최고’라 말하진 않겠다. 이끼라면 역시 야쿠시마(屋久島) 아닌가. 오제보다 석 달 먼저 방문한 ‘야쿠시마’를 소환하는 이유다. 가고시마현 남단의 섬, 야쿠시마는 제주도의 4분의 1 정도 면적으로 원시림을 비롯한 산악 지역이 1993년 유네스코 세계자연유산에 등재됐다.

items.title: 한국에서는 왜 노벨 과학상 수상자가 안 나올까
items.snippet: “우리나라에선 언제쯤 노벨상이 나올까?” 이런 말을 하는 분들이 꽤 많다. 이웃 일본이 거의 매년 노벨상을 받으며 ‘엄친아’ 역할을 하고 있으니, 박탈감이 더 클 수밖에 없다. 물론 우리나라에서도 노벨상이 두 번 나왔다. 2000년 김대중 전 대통령이 평화상을, 2024년에는 한강 작가가 문학상을 탔다. 두 분의 수상은 높이 평가받아야 하지만, 그런데도 우리가 계속 노벨상 타령을 하는 것은 과학 분야 수상자가 나오지 않아서다. 과학 분야 노벨상(이하 과학상)이야말로 국력의 정도를 보여주는 지표이기 때문이다.

items.title: “안내견과 찾은 나의 길… 이젠 다른 이들의 길을 엽니다”
items.snippet: 삼성화재안내견학교 유석종 프로 (아무튼주말 게재 전 사용금지)- 영상미디어 이신영 기자" height="3210" src="https://www.chosun.com/resizer/v2/QNMJHPWJJNGS3A5X6MKGDXTPL4.jpg?auth=7953a36e732eacc19cb5c0fea2126f5becb47f293ff97ad2510258bc5f891b98&smart=true&width=4815&height=3210" width="4815" /> 앞을 볼 수 없는 이들의 자립을 도우며 스스로 길을 찾았다. 유석종(45) 삼성화재 안내견학교 프로는 올해로 20년째 시각장애인과 안내견을 연결하고 있는 ‘매칭 상담 전문가’다. 신청자의 보행 능력과 생활 방식, 재활 의지 등을 고려해 안내견과의 동행이 가능한지 판단하는 게 그의 일이다. 그렇게...

items.title: 떡 먹으려고 KTX 탄다… 2030 ‘떡지순례’ 열풍
items.snippet: 13일 오전 9시 30분 롯데백화점 잠실점 지하 식품관 입구. 문이 열리려면 한 시간이나 남았지만 이미 72명이 대기 중이었다. 이들은 지난 9일부터 15일까지 열린 ‘전국 떡지순례’ 팝업 행사의 입장 번호표를 받기 위해 새벽부터 집을 나섰다. 줄 맨 앞에 선 남성은 “오전 7시 15분에 도착했다”고 했다. 오전 10시 30분이 되자 대기 인원은 200명을 넘었다. 백화점 관계자는 “일부 인기 떡집은 오후 1시 준비한 떡이 다 팔려 조기 마감할 정도”라며 “떡의 인기를 실감하고 있다”고 했다.

items.title: 경복궁 영추문 앞 그 나무, 위험하다며 자른다는데…
items.snippet: “오래도록 살고 싶어요.” “우리를 자르지 말아요.”

items.title: 우리의 밤은 당신의 낮보다 아름답다
items.snippet: 파리 몽마르트르의 밤을 누군가의 이름으로 기억한다면 단연 앙리 드 툴루즈 로트레크(1864~1901)일 것이다. 화려한 무대, 객석의 웃음소리, 술잔 위로 내려앉은 짙은 피로까지 그가 캔버스에 담아낸 장면들은 지금도 당대의 환희를 생생히 되살린다. 전설적인 카바레 ‘물랭 루주’가 오늘날에도 그의 이름을 딴 툴루즈 로트레크 메뉴를 선보이며 경의를 표하는 까닭이며 세상이 그에게 ‘몽마르트르의 혼’이라는 찬사를 바치는 이유다. 부유한 귀족 출신 화가는 어쩌다 무희와 가수, 거리의 여성들이 살아가는 밤의 환락가를 그리게 됐을까? 그 배경에 샹송 가수 아리스티드 브뤼앙(1851~1925)이 있었다.

items.title: 수집가의 안목이 느껴지는 청화백자 접시
items.snippet: ‘국중박(국립중앙박물관) 분장놀이’에 대한 반응이 이렇게 뜨거울 줄 몰랐다. 발랄하고 개성 넘치는 올해의 대상 수상자와 더불어 청화백자 잉어 모양 연적의 인기도 절정에 올랐기에, 이 기회를 빌려 청화백자 한 점을 소개해보려 한다.

items.title: 우리는 AI를 웃길 수 있을까
items.snippet: 우리는 매일 수많은 사회 현상을 마주합니다. 빠르게 번지는 유행, 집단적 쏠림 현상, 그리고 이해하기 어려운 선택의 반복…. 사람들은 왜 그렇게 생각하고 행동하는 걸까요? 인지심리학자인 김경일 아주대 심리학과 교수가 겉으로 드러난 현상 이면에 작동하는 기제가 개인의 선택과 집단의 움직임에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 짚어봅니다. – 편집자 주

items.title: 어제보다 먼 곳으로
items.snippet: 자동차 업계가 자율주행 기술 주도권을 놓고 치열한 경쟁을 벌이고 있습니다. 운전자가 핸들이나 페달을 조작하지 않아도 자동차가 스스로 목적지까지 찾아가게 하는 기술 말이죠. 그런데 이 기술이 정말 절실한 곳은 지구가 아니라 화성인지도 모르겠습니다.

items.title: 그 시절, 좋은 지도자들
items.snippet: 1985년 3월에 54세의 미하일 고르바초프가 소련 최고 지도자로 선출됐습니다. 그는 ‘새로운 사고(思考)’를 내세우며 ‘페레스트로이카’와 ‘글라스노스트’, 즉 ‘개혁’과 ‘개방’을 주창했습니다. 이른바 ‘민주주의적 공산주의’를 주장한 것입니다. 그것은 폴란드 철학자 레셰크 코와코프스키가 사용한 표현에 따르면 ‘구워진 눈덩이’와 같은 것이었습니다. 과연 고르바초프가 눈덩이를 구울 수 있을까? 큰 의문이었습니다. 그는 비정통적인 방식의 협상 제안과 매력적인 공격으로 서방 측을 부드럽게 압박했습니다. 많은 서방 측 지도자들이 당황했습니다. 독일 헬무트 콜 총리는 고르바초프를 일단 선전술의 귀재로 보았습니다. 미심쩍어하면서도 큰 틀의 역사적 화해를 생각했습니다. 콜 총리는 한 인터뷰에서 나치의 괴벨스도 선전술의 대가였다고 언급했습니다. 물론 비보도...

items.title: 부드럽게 풀려 산뜻하게 녹아드는 맛
items.snippet: 어머니와 스시를 먹으면 꼭 아버지 이야기를 하게 된다. “너희 아빠가 그렇게 스시를 좋아했는데 나중엔 먹지도 못하고.” 아버지는 간암 진단을 받고 얼마 후에 의사에게서 ‘날것을 삼가는 게 좋겠다’는 말을 들었다. 그 이후 아버지는 날것을 먹지 않았다. 어머니도 덩달아 스시 먹을 일이 사라졌다. 평생 먹는 것을 참는 게 힘들던 아버지는 생애 마지막에는 그 어떤 음식을 가져가도 고개를 저었다. 아버지께 ‘드시라’고 애원하는 날이 찾아오리라고는 생각하지 못했다. 아버지와 달리 어머니는 먹는 데 취미가 없었다. 건강 진단을 받으면 백이면 백 “식사를 잘해야 한다”는 말을 듣는 것도 오래됐다. 회사 쉬는 날 어머니와 따로 약속을 잡는 데는, 한 끼라도 제대로 채워주고 싶은 노림수도 있었다.

items.title: 알고 보면 역사가 길지 않은 각국 대표 음식들
items.snippet: 다양한 외국 음식이 우리 식단을 더 풍성하게 만들고 있다. 그런데 오랜 세월 이어져 왔을 것 같은 각국 대표 음식 중에 의외로 역사가 길지 않은 경우가 많다. 미국을 상징하는 햄버거는 19세기 말 독일 이주민들이 함부르크 스타일로 구운 스테이크를 넣어 팔던 네모난 샌드위치에서 유래했다. 오늘날의 형태를 갖춘 건 1916년 동그란 모양의 햄버거용 번이 나오면서부터였고 1950년대 맥도날드·버거킹 같은 대형 프랜차이즈가 성장하면서 미 전역으로 확산됐다.

items.title: 인텔, CPU 최적화 AI 추론 소프트웨어 선봬
items.snippet: 인텔이 서버용 중앙처리장치(CPU) 제온 프로세서의 인공지능(AI) 추론 성능을 극대화하는 '인텔 인퍼런스 마이크로서비스(Inference Microservice)'를 16일 공개했다.대규모 언어 모델(LLM)을 CPU에 맞춰 최적화 작업을 빠르게 처리하는 가상화(컨테이너) 소프트웨어다. 개방형(오픈소스) LLM 모델 실행에 필요한 코드, 엔진, 설정값 등 라이브러리를 담았다.소프트웨어가 구동되면 인텔 프로세서를 감지하고, 사전 검증해 조율한 최적의 AI 추론 설정값을 적용한다. items.title: Extended strange metal and superconductivity in partially filled moiré Hubbard bands
items.abstract: Moiré semiconductors provide a physical realization of the Hubbard model. Bandwidth-tuned Mott transitions and complex phase diagrams mimicking those of high-temperature superconductors have been demonstrated near a weak Mott insulating state at half-band-filling. The platform also provides an opportunity to explore the physics of a partially filled Hubbard band at doping densities far away from the Mott insulator, a regime that has remained largely unexplored. Here we report the emergence of an extended strange metal (ESM), in both doping density and twist angle, in a partially filled Hubbard band of twisted bilayer WSe2. The ESM is in the clean limit, persists down to 100mK, and spans over multiple symmetry-breaking ground states; it also appears only at small twist angles, where electronic correlations are strong. These observations distinguish the state from the reported strange meta...

items.title: Energetics of Fault-Tolerant Spin-Qubit Quantum Computation
items.abstract: Semiconductor spin qubits offer a promising route to compact and scalable quantum computers, combining long coherence times in isotopically purified silicon with compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing. Beyond computational speedup, their energy efficiency is an important consideration for future large-scale systems. We evaluate the power and energy requirements of a Loss-DiVincenzo spin-qubit quantum computer by analyzing the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) and benchmarking it against the classical Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). We develop a detailed energy budget, identifying cryogenic cooling as the dominant baseline contribution before quantum error correction (QEC). The comparison between the QFT and the classical FFT reveals that, for any quantum workload operating under a polynomially bounded sampling regime, the crossover in energy consumption occurs at smaller problem size...

items.title: Low magnon damping of a EuSe film down to millikelvin temperatures
items.abstract: The rapid development of quantum magnonics over the past decade has created a demand for magnetic materials that keep their magnon losses low at millikelvin temperatures and add functionality beyond that of the established iron garnets and ferromagnetic metals. The europium chalcogenides are natural candidates $-$ they are magnetic semiconductors whose moment of $7\,μ_{\mathrm{B}}$ per Eu$^{2+}$ ion stems from a half-filled $4f$ shell with zero orbital momentum, so that spin-orbit coupling and intrinsic damping are expected to be weak. All five allotropes are confirmed to satisfy the Born stability criteria and to display positive phonon frequencies throughout the Brillouin zone, i.e., they are mechanically and dynamically stable. Electronic structure calculations show that qtz Si is a semimetal with a vanishing gap, whereas dia Si and lon Si are semiconductors, and bsn and gsi allotropes are weakly metallic. items.title: Robust Data-Driven Controller Synthesis from Sampled and Uncertain Frequency Response Estimates using Integral Quadratic Constraints
items.abstract: In this paper, we develop a novel MIMO controller synthesis method that relies solely on frequency-domain data of discrete-time systems. The approach is based on an iterative design procedure using \emph{integral quadratic constraints} (IQCs). It generalizes existing data-driven methods that approximate semi-infinite IQC conditions by enforcing them on a finite set of measured frequency points. Such approximations do not provide guarantees on the continuous frequency axis and may fail to capture inter-frequency behavior. We address this limitation by formulating a convex optimization problem that preserves robustness guarantees over the entire frequency range. In particular, the proposed method explicitly accounts for inter-frequency behavior of both plant and controller, leading to certified robust stability and performance. items.title: The Reciprocal tau-Cell: A Log-Domain Circuit for On-Chip Learning
items.abstract: Training hardware by gradient descent requires a gradient to be computed using a separate backwards pass. If a circuit is reciprocal, meaning every connection is symmetric, the backward pass is the same network run a second time with the error as its input. The reciprocal tau-cell, a weak-inversion log-domain circuit, makes this practical in standard CMOS. Each cell is a current-mode leaky integrator with a built-in ReLU; each connection is two transistors whose signed strength is a ratio of bias currents. The equilibrium of the network is the solution to a convex program, and latching the cells that are off will hardware linearise the circuit, making its second run exactly linear. items.title: CAFE: Conducting-Cell-Aware Adaptive Differential Encoding for Robust DNN Inference in FeFET-Based Compute-in-Memory
items.abstract: Ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET)-based compute-in-memory (CIM) promises energy-efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference, but device variation can severely degrade bit-sliced CIM accuracy. Prior works either rely on hardware modifications or treat such variation as generic noise, overlooking a key FeFET asymmetry: negligible off-state leakage makes errors dominated by conducting on-state cells. This asymmetry is amplified by two's-complement sign extension, which maps small negative values to high-significance bit slices and magnifies their errors during shift-and-add reconstruction. In this paper, we propose CAFE, a conducting-cell-aware adaptive differential encoding framework built upon this FeFET-specific asymmetry. CAFE introduces C$^2$AM, a bit-significance-weighted conducting-cell activity metric that predicts output deviation and inference accuracy degradation un...

items.title: Pressure engineering of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape and exciton-charge interplay in semiconductor moiré superlattices
items.abstract: Semiconductor moiré superlattices, owing to strongly bound excitons and pronounced electronic correlation, have emerged as an intriguing solid platform for exploring correlated bosonic phenomena, where the moiré potential landscape plays a central role. Hydrostatic pressure allows continuous, in-situ tuning of this landscape, but remains underexplored because of experimental challenges. Here we integrate a diamond anvil pressure cell with high quality dual gated WSe2/WS2 twisted bilayers and perform cryogenic optical spectroscopy. We observe distinct pressure evolutions of moiré intralayer excitons, which reveal drastic modulation of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape captured by a continuum model and suggest the capability of engineering the exciton-band topology. items.abstract: We propose CktHGVAE, a heterogeneous graph variational autoencoder for transistor-level analog/mixedsignal CMOS circuits that takes not only design variables but also state variables as its inputs and outputs. Latent-space optimization in the PCA-reduced latent space with Bayesian optimization, evolutionary search, random search, and quasi-exhaustive search is demonstrated for a common-source voltage amplifier with NMOS input and resistive load, where the objective function is defined as a penalty for deviation from required circuit specifications. items.abstract: Tracing my scientific path from many-body physics in semiconductor nanostructures to topological quantum matter, this Habilitation à diriger des recherches (HDR) memoir presents only part of my research since defending two PhD theses in Toulouse and Nizhny Novgorod in 2011. Focusing on pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures, it highlights my independent research program: identifying physical problems, developing predictive theories, and initiating new directions with experimentalists. The first part addresses Kane fermions in bulk HgCdTe: temperature-driven band inversion, domain-wall states, the collapse of Landau levels in crossed electric and magnetic fields, and disorder-induced topological transitions. items.abstract: Strong coupling between mobile charge carriers or excitons and lattice vibrations gives rise to polarons: quasiparticles formed by charge carriers dressed by a cloud of phonon excitations. Polaron formation determines transport properties of systems ranging from transition-metal oxides and organic semiconductors to light-harvesting complexes. In excitonic systems that admit a hard-core boson description, mapping the excitations to pseudospins provides a natural framework for studying polaron physics, including the nonperturbative regime in which hopping amplitudes, phonon energies, and coupling strengths are comparable. items.title: Single anyons and anyon binding in a quantum Hall dot
items.abstract: Anyons are particles with quantized fractional statistics. In theory, a single anyon can be stabilized as a localized fractional charge within the bulk of a topologically ordered two-dimensional insulator. However, experiments to date have focused on probing anyons in structures in which many anyonic excitations coexist and interact. Here, we demonstrate the trapping of a single anyon in a device consisting of a graphene-based quantum point contact with an embedded tunable quantum Hall dot. Benchmarking our device at v = 1, we demonstrate backscattering between Fermi liquid edge states mediated by the whole-electron Coulomb blockade of the dot. The cleanliness and control available in our device allow depletion of the dot to the last quasihole, and we observe spin blockade for transitions to the opposite-spin Landau level. Varying the nitrogen and oxygen supply yields monoclinic beta-Ga2O3, predominantly disordered films and crystalline spinel GaON. items.title: Coherent Phonon Generation from Prethermal Carrier Populations in a Semiconductor
items.abstract: Ultrafast laser excitation of carriers in semiconductors often results in the creation of fully symmetric coherent optical phonons, typically understood in terms of a thermalized transient carrier population. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. The measured spectral dependence is instead reproduced by a transition-resolved prethermal force weighted by optical matrix elements and band- and momentum-dependent $A_1$ deformation potentials. items.title: Tellurium trioxide as an n-type wide-gap semiconductor with ultrahigh work functions from first principles
items.abstract: The exploration of next-generation wide-gap semiconductors with extreme work functions is highly desirable for the continued advancement of electronic and optoelectronic devices. By using first principles calculations, we show that \b{eta}-TeO3, with a wide band gap exceeding 3 eV, emerges as a promising n-type semiconductor exhibiting ultrahigh work functions of up to ~8 eV. Intentionally or unintentionally incorporated interstitial H, Li, Na, Cu, Mg, and Zn impurities and substitutional F impurities are identified as shallow donors, whereas O vacancies act as minor carrier-compensating defects that locally trap electrons at neighbouring Te sites. The work function is evaluated across a series of low-index nonpolar surfaces. items.abstract: While most studies on Co$2$MnAl (CMA) focus on the ultrathin regime for spintronic junctions, applications scaling with magnetic volume--such as Anomalous Nernst Effect (ANE) energy harvesters, integrated power inductors, and magnetic MEMS--require significantly thicker films. In this work, 750 nm thick CMA films were grown on MgO (001) and Si substrates to establish a roadmap for their thermal integration. Structural analysis reveals that B2 ordering is optimized on MgO at 600 $^\circ$C, which is important for functional devices. In contrast, samples on Si substrates exhibit a disorder transition toward the A2 phase, closely linked to diffusion-driven degradation processes. items.title: Theory of deeply subwavelength electromagnetic structuring of semiconductors due to thermal-ionization instability
items.abstract: We develop a theory of ionization-assisted instability that governs the reflection of intense electromagnetic pulses from a semiconductor surface. Local overheating of the material increases the free-carrier density and conductivity, which in turn enhances the absorption of the incident radiation and further amplifies local heating and avalanche ionization. At high pump repetition rates, the overheating accumulates from pulse to pulse, leading to a gradual rise of the local material temperature and free carrier density - a positive feedback loop that drives thermal runaway. However, this effect competes with diffraction of the pump field on the emerging perturbation of the dielectric permittivity or on the surface relief, which reduces the local electric field amplitude in the overheated regions, thus providing negative feedback. items.title: Mixed Precision Scaling Laws for Quantized Pretraining
items.abstract: Since scaling laws were introduced for modern LLMs (Kaplan et al., 2020), several works have extended them to account for quantization, tracking the emerging low-precision data types supported on AI accelerators. We develop a more accurate scaling law for quantized pretraining with mixed precision across the forward and backward passes, grounded in optimization theory and validated empirically. Our formulation separates the effects of quantization on model capacity and on optimization efficiency, and explicitly models the persistent optimization error from forward and backward quantization identified through convergence analysis. To select the regimes for fitting and evaluating our law, we first decompose existing 4-bit training recipes into their forward and backward components, isolating those that most affect loss. items.title: First-Principles Calculations of the Electron-Hole-Pair Creation Energy in Semiconductors and Dielectrics
items.abstract: We present first-principles calculations of the electron-hole-pair creation energy in semiconductors and dielectrics, focusing in particular on AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2. We have employed density functional theory (DFT) to calculate the band structure, density-functional perturbation theory to obtain the phonon dispersion, and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) to calculate the electron energy loss function (via the dielectric function). We performed full-band Monte Carlo simulations of electron thermalization for energies up to ~100 eV and calculated the average energy required to excite an electron-hole pair. We calculated pair-creation energies of approximately 12.2, 6.5, 7.3, 3.10, and 16.7 eV/pair for AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2, respectively. items.abstract: Four-level indium-gallium-zinc oxide (IGZO) 2T0C memory needs reliable state formation, sensing references, and a path from cell errors to digital weights. We analyze 107 measured DC transfer curves from 37 isolated IGZO transistors (W/L = 3/0.5 micrometers). Four gate-bias operating points inferred from the first sweep are evaluated on later sweeps of 35 devices. Device-resolved operating points reduce second-sweep across-device current standard deviation by 49.4-52.4%, yet retaining initial thresholds increases misclassified points from 37/140 to 55/140. Leave-one-device-out reference estimation gives 0/140 on the second sweep; freezing second-sweep thresholds yields 6/140 on the third. Sampling eight reference transistors on the third sweep gives a mean held-out error fraction of 0.15% over 2,000 selections, versus 4.33% with frozen thresholds on matched held-out devices. items.title: Stateless Stochastic Computing for Generative AI on Superconducting Logic: A Model-Hardware Co-Design
items.abstract: Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average. Recently, thermodynamic computing has been demonstrated on several hardware platforms, including digital CMOS circuits based on stochastic computing. Superconducting single-flux-quantum (SFQ) logic offers very high clock rates and very low switching energy, but it heavily penalizes state, memory, fan-out, and feedback, i.e., exactly the per-neuron accumulators on which such designs rely. We therefore realize thermodynamic computing in SFQ logic through a co-design of a generative model and its circuit in which the datapath holds no state at all. (A) On an open PDK (SKY130), a cloud LLM agent designed an 11-bit, 5.12-MS/s SAR ADC from its specification. The agents produced DRC- and LVS-clean macros and met the specification after parasitic extraction (PEX). In particular, under the condition in which the agent received a sanitized reference design derived from our 65-nm design (vibe porting), it produced the best layout in the shortest time. Its area was 1/1.6 to 1/2.8 of that of the conditions without a reference. This condition reached signoff without human intervention. items.title: Localized Joule heating and carbonization process optimization of 3D printed polymer structures for lab-on-CMOS applications
items.abstract: Use of carbon electrodes integrated with CMOS technology has great promise for lab-on-chip, biomedical, environmental, and industrial applications. One method of developing carbon electrodes is to 3D print polymer nanostructures on a CMOS chip, and use a thermal annealing process to pyrolyze them into carbon at high temperature, approximately 950 °C. Such high temperature is detrimental to the CMOS sensor circuits, causing severe degradation. We present a novel solution of localized Joule heating of these polymer nanostructures to achieve complete carbonization of the electrodes. Both analytical and COMSOL simulations guided the experiments to characterize the carbonization process conditions. items.title: TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions
items.abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. items.abstract: Bismuth oxyselenide (Bi2O2Se) has emerged as a leading semiconductor candidate for next-generation electronics and quantum phenomena research. However, its strong ionic interlayer bonding of Se layers fundamentally restricts the full potential of this otherwise promising quasi-two-dimensional (2D) material. In this work, we demonstrate chlorine substitution as an effective strategy to introduce van der Waals gaps and modify the electronic structure of the system. Through comprehensive transport and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements on Bi6O6Se2Cl2 single crystal, an optimal Cl-doping compound, we show that the key electronic features, including indirect band gap, high electron mobility, and carrier effective mass, are well preserved, while the 2D character of the system is sufficiently enhanced. items.abstract: A Muon Collider is one of the most attractive routes to multi-TeV lepton collisions, but it requires the accelerator and detector communities to solve a tightly coupled set of problems that have no close precedent in an operating collider. Muons must be produced, captured, cooled, accelerated, and collided before they decay. The detector must then extract clean physics from an environment dominated by decay products from the beamline. Artificial intelligence is not a substitute for accelerator physics, detector design, or engineering validation. It is, however, unusually well matched to several of the central obstacles: high-dimensional design spaces, expensive simulations, coupled subsystem trade-offs, and workflows that are currently too slow or too fragile to support broad design exploration. items.title: Revealing New Leakage Paths in GAAFETs using Predictive First-Principles Simulations
items.abstract: Gate-All-Around Field-Effect Transistors (GAAFETs) are emerging as successors to Fin Field-Effect Transistors (FinFETs) and are central to continued scaling at advanced semiconductor nodes. Despite their improved electrostatic control, recent measurements show that the drain current in GAAFETs deviates strongly from thermionic behavior at negative gate voltages, increasing as the gate voltage becomes more negative. This leakage has been attributed to direct gate-drain tunneling through the high-$k$ dielectric, enhanced by drain-induced dielectric barrier lowering (DIDBL). Here, we use predictive, charge-self-consistent Non-Equilibrium Green Function (NEGF) simulations based on the Contact Block Reduction (CBR) method to spatially resolve this leakage pathway in GAAFETs. items.title: DFIT: A Framework for Building Instrumentation Tools Across Heterogeneous Dataflow Accelerators
items.abstract: Emerging dataflow accelerators offer exceptional energy efficiency and throughput for machine learning workloads, yet remain largely opaque to developers for performance analysis. Unlike CPUs and GPUs, where instrumentation frameworks enable fine-grained introspection, dataflow hardware exposes little information. This lack of transparency limits the ability of compiler engineers, system designers, and application developers to analyze, tune, or debug accelerator behavior. In this paper, we introduce DFIT (DataFlow Accelerator Instrumentation Tool), an instrumentation framework designed specifically for dataflow architectures. DFIT directly instruments operations, regions, and compiler transformations at the graph IR and backend-lowering stages using semantic program representation. DFIT captures high-level, semantically meaningful data that reflect the true dataflow of computation. Thes...

items.title: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
items.abstract: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. items.title: Bottom-Up Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering for the Detection of Micro-Objects and Globular Analytes
items.abstract: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) is typically achieved by depositing the analyte on a metal or semiconductor substrate. We propose a bottom-up approach, enabling SERS by depositing a metal on the surface of the object being studied. A Mie-theory analysis of electric-field enhancement in dielectric core-shell particles is presented. A correlative approach combining SERS, atomic force microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy is employed to model the conditions required for sensitive SERS detection and spectral analysis of polystyrene microspheres (PMSs) as models of globular and vesicle-like objects. items.title: Theory of exciton-exciton interactions in crystalline systems
items.abstract: Excitons are bound electron-hole pairs in semiconductors whose interactions influence optical properties and determine their collective behavior and emergent correlated phases. Despite the theoretical and experimental significance of these phenomena, a microscopic theory of exciton-exciton interactions that takes into account the full composite nature of these quasiparticles is lacking. Here, we present a general theory of exciton-exciton interactions that builds upon our previous publication [Physical Review B 113, 155440 (2026)], which applied only to conventional semiconductors with weak band hybridization. By contrast, the theory presented here is valid in virtually any crystalline semiconducting system and can be applied to the study of biexciton formation and correlated excitonic phases in systems where band topology, quantum geometry, and moiré effects play a significant role. items.title: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
items.abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. Across two annual cycles, AI-HDL grew from 172 to 604 participants and from 40 to 108 teams, reaching 30 universities, six community colleges, and 19 countries. In the 2026 cohort, 68.7% of participants reported no prior Verilog experience. Twenty-two teams completed the four design phases and reached final evaluation. Our key observation is a pronounced negative differential longitudinal resistance (NDLR) in the four-probe response near switching currents, while no such feature appears in two-terminal measurements. items.abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. items.title: Effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of CrSBr
items.abstract: We present a systematic study of the effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of the van der Waals layered semiconductor CrSBr. Our study shows that even at substitution level of $x=56\%$ the $\mathrm{CrSBr_{1-x}Cl_{x}}$ material exhibits qualitatively the same clear magneto-optical coupling that was observed in pure CrSBr crystals. The values of the relevant parameters are shown to vary smoothly across different substitution levels, thus offering promising tunability for this family of 2D magnetic materials.

items.abstract: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy $E_\rm U$ ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges ($E_\rm U$ ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. items.title: Ambipolar metal-insulator transition in bilayer MoSe2
items.abstract: When Coulomb interactions dominate kinetic energy, dilute two-dimensional carriers form a Wigner solid. Both its melting and disorder-driven localization can drive density-tuned metal-insulator transitions, but their relative roles and interplay have been debated for decades. Atomically thin semiconductors offer a new test because transport and scanning tunneling microscopy can probe the same material, yet poor contacts impede transport where correlations are strongest. Here we introduce contact-free radio-frequency reflectometry that senses sheet resistance through capacitive gate coupling. It resolves the electron and previously inaccessible hole transitions in the same bilayer MoSe2 device, whose carriers share disorder but not mass. items.title: MarketRank: ranking stocks by the stationary probabilities of a Markov chain over estimated money flows, with a topological landscape view
items.abstract: Every trading day, money leaves some stocks and moves into others. MarketRank asks where that money concentrates and how the concentration shifts over time. It treats the market as a Markov chain whose states are stocks. The chance of moving from one stock to another is the share of the first stock's outgoing dollars that goes to the second, and a stock's MarketRank score is its long run (stationary) probability in that chain, computed by damped power iteration on a sparse transition matrix. PageRank ranks web pages with the same idea, using links instead of dollars. Who sold what to buy what is not public, so the flows are estimated from daily prices and volumes with a correlation tilted gravity model, in a deterministic parallel C++ engine. items.title: Superconducting edge contact to a buried Ge quantum well
items.abstract: Semiconductor-superconductor hybrid systems form the basis for a broad range of quantum phenomena, such as Andreev bound states, topological superconductivity, and hybrid quantum Hall states. The performance of these hybrid systems can strongly benefit from the exceptional electronic properties of heterostructures with deeply buried quantum wells. However, establishing high-quality superconducting contacts to such quantum wells remains challenging. Here, we address this problem with an edge-contact approach that combines anisotropic dry etching to access the quantum well followed by wet etching for interface preparation. items.title: Squeezed light from a semiconductor amplifier
items.abstract: The possibility of generating light in a squeezed quantum state during saturated light amplification in a semiconductor amplifier is theoretically analyzed. Due to four-wave mixing process during amplification, weak components of the spontaneous emission of the medium with symmetric frequency shifts relative to the strong amplified wave acquire the quantum properties of two-mode squeezed light. The squeezing of quadrature components occurs in the range of frequency shifts of several GHz ($\sim$ the inverse relaxation time of the charge carrier density) and can reach 10 dB or more under optimal conditions. The formation of a two-mode squeezing phase facilitates the observation of the squeezing effect, in which a strong wave, playing the role of a local wave, exhibits quadrature noise suppression without additional homodyne detection.

items.title: Two-exciton bound states in the Merrifield exciton model
items.abstract: Understanding the formation and dynamics of two-exciton bound states (BSs) is crucial for harnessing multi-exciton phenomena and designing next-generation organic semiconductor materials. While various mechanisms such as intermolecular exciton-exciton interactions or multi-level intramolecular configurations can generate these BSs, a fundamental understanding of their underlying lattice dynamics remains a key challenge. Within this context, the Merrifield exciton model stands out as a premier framework for capturing the intricate quantum mixing between single-site doubly-excited states and two-particle scattering continuum. In this work, by constructing a set of exact two-exciton Bloch states and applying a plane-wave ansatz to treat the resulting inhomogeneous tridiagonal matrices, we provide a complete, rigorous solution to the two-exciton problem in a finite-size Merrifield chain. items.title: Sparse qubit operation in a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array
items.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires increasing the qubit count while maintaining high performance and connectivity. Semiconductor qubits have demonstrated high-fidelity operation, but growing the system size at sufficient connectivity remains challenging, such that scaling mainly occurred in one spatial direction to preserve access for control lines in the other. Here, we realise an approach that relaxes the requirements on fabrication and demonstrate a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array, defined by a shared barrier gate and individual plunger gates. The quantum dots are tuned through coherent spin shuttling over distances up to 5.2um into a sparse configuration of 10 simultaneously operated qubits, leaving space for shuttling connections. items.title: CacheFit: The Rising Cost of Cache Replacement and Constraint-Driven Redesign of Last-Level Cache Replacement Policies
items.abstract: The latency, power, and area costs of LLC replacement remain poorly explored not because simulators cannot be instrumented--event counters feeding a power model are routine--but because no cost model takes a replacement policy as input. CACTI and McPAT price regular structures, a cache or a core, not the small, oddly shaped arrays and dependent logic a policy is made of, and no event count reveals a victim-selection path's logic depth. Without a model, cost has never been an objective a policy search could optimize. In practice, a policy is first selected in simulation for its IPC, and its cost is reduced later in RTL, after the algorithm is fixed. Cost thus enters the design too late to shape it. This paper asks what happens when cost is present from the start. We build CacheFit, the first policy-design loop for LLC replacement with circuit-level cost inside the search objective. CacheF...

items.title: 2d-fet-bench: from spatial reasoning to fet design on flakes
items.abstract: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. To our knowledge, no executable benchmark tests whether language-model agents can perform this flake-specific construction reliably. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. items.title: Hall conductance of dilute electrolytes from odd stochastic density functional theory
items.abstract: Electrolytes under an external magnetic field exhibit a Hall conductivity, much like metals and semiconductors. However, existing theories fail to quantitatively account for their measured Hall conductivities. To make progress toward such a theory, we develop a stochastic density functional framework for electrolytes in a magnetic field. This framework, which we dub odd SDFT, extends the celebrated stochastic density functional theory (SDFT) to incorporate transverse mobilities and chiral time-correlated noise. Using this framework, we calculate the Hall conductivity in the absence of hydrodynamic solvent effects through three approaches: (i) direct response, (ii) Green-Kubo relation, and (iii) a hybrid fluctuation-dissipation relation. We further show that odd SDFT applies more broadly to fluids with broken time-reversal and mirror symmetry, including odd-diffusive fluids and chiral act...

items.title: Vacancy aggregation enhances NV- spin coherence in diamond: a cluster-correlation-expansion study of multi-vacancy spin baths in semiconductors
items.abstract: Annealing a semiconductor makes its vacancies mobile; they aggregate into multi-vacancy complexes that often carry spin. Such centres are a magnetic-noise source for any spin qubit among them, in silicon and silicon carbide as well as in diamond, and they are accordingly blamed for NV-decoherence in irradiated and implanted diamond, with two coherence records credited to removing them. Cluster-correlation-expansion simulations driven by published electron-paramagnetic-resonance parameters invert that attribution. At a fixed paramagnetic spin density a multi-vacancy bath gives a Hahn-echo coherence time 3.1-7.1 times longer than a bath of isolated negative vacancies, over three decades of concentration. A bath dephases the qubit because its spins exchange spin projections with one another, and two can exchange only if their transition frequencies match. A fine-structure splitting shifts t...

Using the silicon vacancy (V$_\mathrm{Si}$) in silicon carbide (SiC) as a model system, we show that a widely used contact metal, nickel (Ni), intrinsically perturbs the defect spin state and quenches the characteristic emission from the spin-quartet channel of V$_\mathrm{Si}$. Low-energy muon spin rotation further reveals that Ni contacts create a magnetically contaminated region extending at least $\sim$110 nm into the SiC, in stark contrast to non-magnetic contacts such as Ti and Al. items.title: First-principles theory of phonon renormalization from nonlinear electron-phonon interactions
items.abstract: Electron-phonon interactions renormalize phonon frequencies and lifetimes and are central to the dynamical properties of solids. While these effects are usually described within linear electron-phonon coupling, the role of nonlinear electron-phonon interactions for phonon properties remains largely unexplored. In this work, we study phonon renormalization arising from the long-range linear one-electron-one-phonon and the nonlinear one-electron-two-phonon interactions within a diagrammatic framework. We derive the corresponding self-energy diagrams, which depend on the chemical potential and temperature, and evaluate them from first principles for the two polar semiconductors LiF and KTaO$_3$. In both materials, the two interaction channels renormalize the phonon spectrum in qualitatively distinct ways. The linear contribution is sharply localized near the Brillouin-zone center, whereas t...

items.title: An Emerging NVM-Based On-Chip Training Architecture with Non-Ideality Mitigation Through Bipolar Weight Distributions
items.abstract: The rapid advancement of deep learning has presented significant energy efficiency challenges to the conventional von Neumann architecture. In-memory computing (IMC) architectures based on emerging non-volatile memory (eNVM) are widely regarded as a promising solution for accelerating neural network training due to their high parallelism and low power consumption. However, the intrinsic non-idealities of eNVM devices can cause conductance updates to deviate from target values, thereby limiting the performance of on-chip training. To address this challenge, this paper presents a Non-ideality Optimized eNVM Accelerator (NOVA) architecture for on-chip training. Specifically, we first fabricate a two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET) and develop a conductance modulation behavioral model calibrated with experimental data. Building upon this device model, we propos...

items.title: Compact Modeling of Oxide-Semiconductor, 2D Material, Carbon Nanotube, and Cryogenic Transistors with Experiment Verification
items.abstract: This paper presents a unified compact model for emerging transistor technologies, including oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (OSFETs), 2D material FETs (2DFETs), carbon nanotube FETs (CNFETs), and cryogenic MOSFETs. A unified charge-density formulation is developed to account for quantum confinement, trap charges, and band-tail states in channel charge calculations. A physics-based transport model is introduced to seamlessly capture carrier transport from the long-channel diffusive regime to the short-channel ballistic limit. Scaling models are incorporated to accurately describe 2D electrostatic effects. Cryogenic operation is modeled through the inclusion of band-tail states and temperature-dependent mobility and threshold voltage. The proposed model is validated against experimental data from the fabricated OSFETs with multiple channel lengths and published measurements of...

items.title: Optically Coupled Noise Spectroscopy Quantifies Defect Passivation in Monolayer MoS2 FETs
items.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers are promising materials for electronic and photonic applications, yet the performance of chemical vapour deposition grown samples is severely limited by native sulphur vacancies that introduce mid-gap trap states, degrade carrier mobility, and elevate electrical noise. Here we investigate octanethiol passivation of sulphur vacancies in monolayer MoS2 field effect transistors, combining x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, photoluminescence, and Raman scattering with electrical transport and optically coupled low-frequency noise spectroscopy. Thiol treatment reduces the sulphur vacancy concentration from 7% to 4%, reducing the free electron density. Electrically, it increases the device resistance 35-fold while restoring gate switching with an on/off ratio of 10^4 and improving field-effect mobility from 1 to 5 cm^2/Vs. Low frequency noise spectrosc...

items.title: On-chip nanoplasma for adaptive electromagnetic protection
items.abstract: Over the past decade, semiconductor diodes have served as the primary switching elements in adaptive electromagnetic (EM) protection, yet their performance has been compromised by parasitic effects and thermal accumulation, rendering them inadequate against the rapidly evolving landscape of high-power microwave (HPM) threats. Here we show that on-chip nanoplasma switches (NPMS), composed of gallium nitride electrodes on silicon carbide substrates, exhibit superior radio frequency (RF) and thermal characteristics, positioning them as ideal field-driven switches in RF front-end protectors. By integrating NPMS into metasurfaces, antennas and circuit limiters, we achieve an adaptive response that ensures low-loss transmission for normal signals and high shielding against HPMs, while offering extended operating bandwidth and substantially higher tolerance than conventional solid-state devices...

items.title: Inverse-Designed High-Q/V Silicon Nitride Photonic Crystal Cavities for Second- and Third-Harmonic Generation
items.abstract: SiN photonic crystal (PhC) cavities are promising platforms for nonlinear and quantum photonics because of their wide transparency window, CMOS compatibility, and negligible two-photon absorption. However, realizing high-Q/V cavities remains challenging because of the relatively low refractive index of SiN. Here, we employ inverse design to optimize a two-dimensional SiN PhC cavity and experimentally demonstrate a quality factor of approximately 80,000, the highest reported for a near-stoichiometric SiN 2D PhC cavity. Furthermore, both second- and third-harmonic generation are observed from the same cavity, providing experimental evidence of strong optical confinement and large Q/V. Our results establish inverse-designed SiN PhC cavities as a promising platform for nonlinear photonics and future heterogeneous integrated photonic devices.

items.title: Approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser for reducing energy consumption
items.abstract: Photonic reservoir computing is a promising physical machine-learning approach for time-series prediction. Quantization of the reservoir response signal is an important consideration in the implementation of photonic reservoir computing, and the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency need to be optimized to achieve high prediction performance and low energy consumption. However, few studies have investigated the effects of the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency on both prediction performance and energy consumption. In this study, we introduce the concept of approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser by quantizing the reservoir node states and output weights. We numerically evaluate the performance of a chaotic time-series prediction task and estimate the energy consumption per sample using a component-level model. By optimizing the number of qu...

items.title: Photon-conserving Raman soliton attractors in focusing and defocusing Kerr media
items.abstract: The sign of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient has long been regarded as irrelevant to the direction of the Raman-induced soliton self-frequency shift. Yet the standard generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) predicts a frequency shift that depends on the sign of the nonlinearity, which leads to an unphysical blue shift in the defocusing case. We resolve this inconsistency by deriving the time-domain form of the photon-conserving GNLSE (pcGNLSE) from its established frequency-domain counterpart. The derivation reveals that photon-number conservation imposes two sign modifications relative to the standard GNLSE: the Raman-shift coefficient acquires the absolute value of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient in place of its signed counterpart, and the self-steepening-Raman dissipation term likewise carries an absolute-value prefactor rather than a signed one. These two modifications jointl...

items.title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
items.abstract: Gold nanonecklace networks exhibit non-Ohmic current--voltage I-V characteristics with a sharp conduction threshold, making them promising for sensing and transistor-like devices. However, their conduction has been understood largely empirically, because experiments cannot see how conduction evolves inside the network. To address this, we develop a graph-based Kirchhoff modeling framework that resolves these internal processes, tracking the potential and current of every junction. Although every active element conducts linearly, the model reproduces the non-Ohmic response $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$. It also captures the experimentally observed effects of junction properties, network density, and voids, which lends confidence to its predicted internal states. These states show that the non-Ohmic response emerges from voltage-driven percolation. Conduction is governed by how junctions are conne...

items.title: Complex frequency-dependent quadrature squeezing in semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We present a comprehensive study of quadrature squeezing in a quantum well laser based on a fully quantum Langevin approach. We compute the frequency-resolved squeezing map of the laser field and identify optimal squeezing curves, revealing, for the first time to our knowledge, both frequency-dependent squeezing and complex or hidden squeezing in a semiconductor laser. We further analyse the role of the linewidth enhancement factor (alpha-factor) in the emergence of these features. Our results establish semiconductor lasers as a platform for the generation of non-classical light and open new perspectives for their application in quantum communication and sensing.

items.title: Electron state tomography from quasiparticle interference maps
items.abstract: Characterizing electronic band structures requires precise knowledge of wave functions and their quantum geometry. Here, we introduce a tomography method to reconstruct the density matrix of electron states from quasiparticle interference maps around single impurities. We consider two-orbital models on a honeycomb lattice, relevant to graphene heterostructures and direct-gap semiconductors. For on-site impurities, backscattering between time-reversed states directly maps the density matrix populations and coherences into distinct orbital contributions in the interference map. While local probes usually lack orbital resolution, these orbital contributions transform under distinct symmetry group representations and can thus be disentangled to reveal the density matrix and quantum geometric tensor of the scattering states. This establishes impurities as tomographic probes for band structure...

items.title: Nanoscopic Multiplexing Optical Data Storage via Chip Fabrication
items.abstract: The accelerating growth of global data demands storage technologies combining high capacity, long lifetime and low energy consumption. Optical storage is attractive for archival applications, but conventional optical writing is constrained by diffraction-limited resolution and scalability, while thermal accumulation limits high-speed writing. Here we shift optical data writing from a serial optical process to a fabrication-defined process, in which lithographic masks govern where material modification occurs. Using patterned resist masks and ion implantation, we create fluorescent information voxels with nanoscale control over millimeter-scale areas. The platform supports multilevel and multidimensional encoding by independently encoding information in fluorescence intensity and wavelength. A machine-learning-assisted super-resolution reconstruction protocol is developed to recover infor...

items.title: Absorption and Phase-Contrast Microtomography Using Direct X-Ray Detection With Commercial Off-The-Shelf CMOS Sensors
items.abstract: This work presents high-resolution X-ray microtomography based on commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) CMOS image sensors as direct detectors. The system uses a microfocus X-ray source in cone-beam geometry, enabling both absorption-contrast imaging, thanks to the sensor s intrinsic resolution, and phase-contrast imaging, by adjusting the object-to-sensor distance. A dynamic flat-field correction algorithm mitigates radiation-induced sensor degradation during long acquisitions. The setup provides voxel sizes from 3.9 microns to 5.2 microns, with an effective spatial resolution (FWHM) as fine as 9.6 microns in magnified phase-contrast mode (1.33x) and 21 microns in non-magnified absorption-contrast mode. Phase contrast enhances visualization of soft tissue boundaries that are difficult to visualize using absorption-contrast imaging in the same experimental configuration.

items.title: Anharmonic Quantum Transport Analysis of Thermal Transport Anomalies in Ultrathin Silicon Nanowires
items.abstract: Thermal transport in low-dimensional semiconductors is important for nanoelectronics, quantum devices, and thermoelectrics. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) studies reveal a nonmonotonic diameter dependence of thermal conductivity in ultrathin silicon nanowires (NWs), but classical MD is limited at low temperatures and under strong confinement. Here, we investigate this anomaly using anharmonic non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) simulations combined with density functional theory-trained neuroevolution potentials. All transport results are expressed as effective thermal conductivities ($κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$) for NW devices with a finite channel length of $L=10$ nm. At 300 K, $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$ decreases with diameter to minima at 6.24 and 5.50 nm for [001]- and [110]-oriented NWs, respectively. At 10 K, the corresponding minima occur at 7.33 and 5.50 nm. items.title: Predictive Software Scheduling as an Early-Warning Hint Layer for Optical Engine Thermal Drift in Heterogeneous SoIC Packaging
items.abstract: As semiconductor scaling approaches the A16 / 2 nm node, the integration of co-packaged optics (CPO) through TSMC's Compact Universal Photonic Engine (COUPE) architecture introduces critical thermal-optical coupling challenges. Micro-ring resonators embedded in the Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) layer are highly sensitive to temperature, with a wafer-level center wavelength deviation of merely +/-1.7 nm across a 300 mm wafer representing the platform's manufacturing control limit. To address this, we propose XRM-SSD V24, a physics-aware scheduling layer that models inference-load density 20-50 ms before execution and issues early-warning hints to the COUPE bias-control firmware, enabling pre-emptive thermal compensation. Simulation-based validation on a software emulation platform (physical characterization pending TSMC tape-out) over 90,000 inference steps yields a simulator-internal...

items.title: Speed Kills: Exploring Confused Deputy Attacks Through Edge AI Accelerators
items.abstract: AI Accelerators (AIAs) are specialized hardware, such as Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), that enable optimal and efficient execution of AI applications and on-device inference. The growing demand for AI applications has led to the widespread adoption of AIAs on edge and embedded devices. Unlike applications, AIAs are not bound by Operating System (OS) restrictions and have limited visibility into Application Processor (AP) security mechanisms (e.g., kernel versus application memory and process isolation). This semantic gap can lead to confused deputy vulnerabilities, where an AIA can be tricked by a malicious application into performing privileged operations on its behalf. In this paper, we conduct the first in-depth study of Confused Deputy Attacks (CDAs) using AIAs. We design DeputyHunt, a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to extract CDA-relevant information for a given AIA...

items.title: Energy Consumption in Next Generation Radio Access Networks
items.abstract: Historically, in macro-cell-based networks, the radio access network (RAN) portion accounts for the largest share of energy consumption in mobile networks. With greater densification, the transition to small cells and increased virtualization of the radio processing functions, the relative energy use of the different network segments is changing. At the same time, open radio access networks (O-RAN) have emerged as a promising approach to support this evolution through open interfaces that enable a multi-vendor environment, support for hierarchical intelligent controls, and simplified, cost-effective radio units that facilitate large-scale deployments. This paper examines the impact of these changes on energy consumption in next-generation RAN architectures through transaction-based energy models. Transaction-based network energy models were developed in 2009 to understand the evolution o...

items.title: Joint Architecture-Token-Bitwidth Multi-Axis Optimization of Vision Transformers for Semiconductor IC Packaging
items.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance in visual recognition, yet their deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments remains limited. The main challenges are their high computational cost, memory requirements, and energy consumption. While individual efficiency techniques such as neural architecture search (NAS), token compression, and low-precision inference have been extensively studied, most prior work targets only a single optimization axis, limiting overall deployment gains while preserving accuracy. In this paper, we present one of the first holistic frameworks that jointly optimizes three complementary axes: architecture, token, and bit-width.
